title: Florida Center for Brain Tumor Research
official: Establishment of a UF Brain Tumor Tissue Bank: Florida Center for Brain Tumor Research
summary: The purpose of this research study is to collect and store brain tumor tissue samples for future research. The samples will become part of the University of Florida Brain Tumor Tissue Bank/Florida Center for Brain Tumor Research. The goal is to find improved treatments and cures for brain tumors.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children and adults scheduled to undergo brain surgery to remove tumor tissue.
